## Download simulated files from HPC
```{bash}
rsync -aP --checksum jc462828@zodiac.hpc.jcu.edu.au:/gpfs01/v2/Q5401/Algorithm_Benchmark_Replicates /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/*fastq.gz
```

## porechop_abi
Porechop ABI is used to trim off the simulated adapters from the simulated reads in the Replicates/ directory
```{bash}
#activate conda environment containing porechop
conda activate porechop_abi_env 
#need to make temp file for porechop to work
chmod u+rwx /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/Replicates/temp_porechop_files

for file in $(ls /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/Replicates) ; do
  prefix=$(basename "$file" .fastq.gz)
  porechopped_file="porechop_${prefix}"
  porechop_abi -abi --custom_adapter /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/Badread_custom_adapter -i "$file" -o "$porechopped_file".fastq -tmp temp_porechop_files/
done

conda deactivate
```

## Return files to HPC for pre-processing
```{bash}
rsync -aP --checksum /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/Algorithm_Benchmark_Replicates/pore*gz jc462828@zodiac.hpc.jcu.edu.au:/gpfs01/v2/Q5401/Algorithm_Benchmark_Replicates
```
